snippet.title: Tachyon Dreams III: The Rancid Buttermilk from Andromeda Trailer
snippet.description:
Tachyon Dreams III is an upcoming free new comedy sci-fi text-parser adventure game that is inspired by early Space Quest games by Sierra from the 80's. 

Follow Dodger on his space-time adventure as he tries to restore peace and balance to the galaxy. 

Tachyon Dreams III will be released at the end of January 2023. Stay tuned! For more news, here is the game's Itch page, where it will be available for download:
https://cosmicvoid.itch.io/tachyon-dreams-iii-the-rancid-buttermilk-from-andromeda

https://twitter.com/Cosmic_Void_
